root_cause: lib/vtls/rustls.c calls Curl_base64_decode() (which allocates through curl's internal, overridable malloc) to obtain the ECHConfig buffer but frees it with the plain libc free() because the translation unit never included curl_memory.h/memdebug.h, which are what redirect malloc/free calls in a given .c file to curl's tracked/overridable allocator functions. This mismatch between the allocator used to obtain memory and the deallocator used to release it is only safe by coincidence in default (no override, no memdebug) builds; it becomes an invalid free once curl's memory function overrides or memory debugging are engaged.
